title: Name a position, not a pile.
prompt: For the rule aₙ = 2ⁿ with indexing beginning at n = 0, which statement is correct?

options.text: a₃ = 8, because the fourth displayed term has index 3.
a₃ = 4, because every sequence must begin at index 1.
The index is irrelevant; only the set of values matters.

feedback.pass: An index selects a value. Changing the indexing convention changes what a₃ refers to.
feedback.fail: The indexing convention was declared as starting at zero. Match positions to values.
